title: Microsoft Teams: desk utilisation analytics in the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal
summary: Hold for corrections to the automation and governance guidance. The building-setting row links to a reference that documents only the read command, the peripheral-script field includes prose rather than a runnable call, and the briefing understates Microsoft's documented coverage of the controls that stop desk reporting.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans bookable-desk utilization analytics in the Teams Pro Management portal.
claims.quote: Teams admins can access utilization analytics for Teams bookable desks on Teams Pro Management portal

claims.claim: The portal already provides meeting-room analytics.
claims.quote: similar to analytics provided for meeting rooms on the portal today

claims.claim: Desk analytics require at least one associated peripheral device.
claims.quote: For utilization analytics to be enabled, a desk needs to have one or more peripheral device associated

claims.claim: Analytics require the desk to have a Teams Shared Space or Teams Shared Space - Single Space license.
claims.quote: the desk needs to be licensed with Teams Shared Space license or Teams Shared Space - Single Space license

claims.claim: MC1490906 names utilization, reservations, occupancy and peak usage patterns as insights.
claims.quote: with insights into desk utilization, reservations, occupancy, and peak usage patterns

claims.claim: MC1490906 names location and desk mode as desk-specific filters.
claims.quote: Desk-specific filters, including location and desk mode

claims.claim: The notice's action section requires associated peripherals and a qualifying desk license, with no other action listed.
claims.quote: To enable utilization analytics, a desk must have one or more associated peripheral devices and be licensed with a Microsoft Teams Shared Space or Microsoft Teams Shared Space - Single Space license.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn calls the portal the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal.
claims.quote: Desk usage reports are located in the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Learn already documents a Desks usage report in the portal.
claims.quote: Teams Rooms Pro Management portal > Analytics & Reports > Reports > Desks usage

claims.where: What's changing; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: The documented desk usage reports are currently in preview.
claims.quote: These reports are currently in preview

claims.claim: Microsoft has not explicitly explained how the planned release relates to the existing preview Desks usage report.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams desk utilization analytics new preview report roadmap 570648 December 2026. Read bookable-desks, teams-shared-device-license, the roadmap and MC1490906; none explicitly maps this release to the preview report.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: The documented report metrics measure only 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM on weekdays.
claims.quote: Metrics only measure usage between 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM on weekdays.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Open questions
claims.claim: The default state of the planned analytics release is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams desk analytics default 570648; Teams desk utilization analytics disable. Read the roadmap, MC1490906, bookable-desks and bring-your-own-device. The sources give prerequisites and existing collection defaults, not this release's arrival default.

claims.claim: The licensing model is add-on.
claims.quote: You purchase one paid Microsoft Teams Shared Space (MTSS) license, and that purchase entitles you to three Microsoft Teams Shared Space Single Space (MTSSS) licenses priced at zero.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The Places licensing page lists the paid license at $8 per desk per month.
claims.quote: Microsoft Teams Shared Space (MTSS) | $8 per desk per month

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Each paid license entitles the organization to three $0 Single Space licenses.
claims.quote: The entitlement ratio is fixed at one paid license to three single-space licenses.

claims.claim: The page gives an effective desk rate of about $2 per desk per month.
claims.quote: Effective desk rate | About $2 per desk per month

claims.claim: The listed costs exclude taxes, fees and other charges.
claims.quote: License costs shown do not include applicable taxes, fees, or other charges, which may vary by region and billing terms.

claims.claim: The single-space licenses must be actively acquired rather than being provisioned automatically.
claims.quote: The three single-space licenses are not generated or provisioned automatically. Purchasing the paid license creates the entitlement; you must then actively acquire the single-space licenses yourself.

claims.claim: Single-space desk licenses cannot be assigned to Teams devices.
claims.quote: Single-space desk licenses are intended only for desks and should not be assigned to Teams devices such as panels or common area phones.

claims.claim: Each desk needs exactly one license to unlock reservation, auto-release/check-in and analytics.
claims.quote: each desk needs exactly one license to unlock three capabilities: reservation, auto-release/check-in, and analytics

claims.claim: The Places page directs MCA purchases to Marketplace in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: This purchase path applies to organizations with a Microsoft Customer Agreement (MCA). Both licenses are available from the Microsoft Teams Shared Space listing in Marketplace.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The Marketplace purchase route requires billing account administrator or billing profile contributor permissions.
claims.quote: Billing account administrator or billing profile contributor permissions. Without them the Marketplace section of the Microsoft 365 admin center will not appear at all, and no order can be placed.

claims.claim: The Places page directs EA purchases to the Volume Licensing Center instead of Marketplace.
claims.quote: If your organization has an Enterprise Agreement (EA), use the Volume Licensing Center instead of the Marketplace purchase flow.

claims.claim: The separate Teams Shared Space licensing page says the Single Space license is available for purchase only with an MCA billing account.
claims.quote: the Single Space license is only available for purchase with an MCA billing account

claims.claim: Learn says accessing the preview desk usage reports does not require a license.
claims.quote: Question: What do I need to access usage reports? Answer: These reports are currently in preview and don't require a license to access.

claims.claim: No separate analytics meter is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams desk analytics meter. Opened bookable-desks, teams-shared-device-license and buy-set-up-teams-shared-space-licenses-desks; read the roadmap and MC1490906. These give license conditions and prices but no separate analytics meter.

claims.claim: Desk licenses are assigned in Microsoft 365 admin center under Users > Active users > desk account > Assign licenses.
claims.quote: expand Users and select Active users. Search for the desk account you want to license and select it to open its details. Choose Assign licenses

claims.claim: The cited general Teams add-on licensing page documents the printed Connect-Graph scopes and Set-MgUserLicense call including -RemoveLicenses @().
claims.quote:
Connect-Graph -Scopes User.ReadWrite.All, Organization.Read.All
Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $user -AddLicenses $addLicenses -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.claim: BYOD Rooms and Desk management is under General in the Teams Pro Management portal.
claims.quote:
BYOD Rooms and Desk management
This setting option is located under the General tab in Teams Pro Management portal

claims.claim: The BYOD Rooms and Desk management setting is enabled by default.
claims.quote: This feature is currently enabled by default, but admins have the option to disable it with this function.

claims.claim: Disabling BYOD Rooms and Desk management stops peripheral ingestion and desk/BYOD reports and hides inventory devices.
claims.quote: controls if peripheral data is ingested into the cloud service ... Disabling this setting will stop showing any reports for BYOD rooms or Desks, and also remove the display of any devices in the Inventory section

claims.claim: No API for the portal's BYOD Rooms and Desk management setting is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Pro BYOD Rooms and Desk management PowerShell API. Opened bring-your-own-device and bookable-desks. Results document the portal toggle and a separate client policy, not an API for this portal toggle.

claims.claim: Portal role management is under Settings > Roles.
claims.quote: In the left navigation of the Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro Management portal, go to Settings > Roles.

claims.claim: Creating or editing portal roles requires Global Administrator, Teams Administrator or Teams Rooms Pro Manager.
claims.quote: To create, edit, or assign roles ... Global Administrator or Teams Administrator through Microsoft Entra ID. Teams Rooms Pro Manager through the Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro Management portal.

claims.claim: Role assignment additionally permits a custom role with role management permissions.
claims.quote: To assign roles, you must be a Global Administrator/ Teams Administrator or Teams Rooms Pro Manager role or have a custom role with role management permissions.

claims.claim: Administrative-unit-scoped Teams Administrators and Teams Devices Administrators cannot access the portal.
claims.quote: Teams Administrator or Teams Devices Administrator assigned to an Administrative Unit (AU), can't access the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal, as AUs aren't currently supported.

claims.claim: The listed Entra roles Global Administrator, Teams Administrator, Teams Devices Administrator and Global Reader provide portal access.
claims.quote: You can assign the below MIcrosoft Entra built-in roles to groups or users to provide access to Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro management portal

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Security & identity; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Portal permissions govern report access, and Site Lead includes report access.
claims.quote: Each role has a set of permissions that determines what users with that role can access and change ... Site Lead: Organizes rooms, has access to reports and can manage tickets.

claims.claim: No automation for the portal's own role definitions and assignments is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Pro Management roles API assign; Teams Pro Management portal role assignment REST API RBAC. Opened rooms-pro-rbac: portal workflows, no API for its own roles. Generic Entra role APIs are a different surface.

claims.claim: Peripheral associations can be imported under Planning > Inventory > Devices > Import.
claims.quote: on the Planning > Inventory > Devices page, select Import to add the device inventory to upload the file you modified

claims.claim: The printed automation field is a runnable invocation of the downloaded peripheral collection script.
claims.quote: Run the script by executing the following command in the PowerShell window: \Get-TeamsBYODSpaceDevices.ps1
claims.fix: Set controls[3].api.call to '.\Get-TeamsBYODSpaceDevices.ps1'. Move '(downloaded script) exports a PERIPHERALS file for import' out of the code field into the note, and state there that it runs from the downloaded script's directory. Preserve the existing docs URL.

claims.where: controls[3].note; Scope; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Automatic peripheral association is supported for individual desks only.
claims.quote: wait for Teams Rooms Pro Management portal to associate the peripheral automatically ... This approach is only supported for individual desks at this time.

claims.claim: The desk auto-association signal threshold is configured under Settings > General.
claims.quote: configurable on Teams Rooms Pro Management portal at Settings > General ... with a minimum of two unique signals and no maximum

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Peripherals are unsupported if their serial numbers cannot be collected, are not unique or contain special characters.
claims.quote: A peripheral device is not supported if its serial number cannot be collected, is not unique, or contains special characters.

claims.claim: Set-CSTeamsBYODAndDesksPolicy configures DeviceDataCollection and Grant-CSTeamsBYODAndDesksPolicy assigns the named policy to a user.
claims.quote:
Set-CSTeamsBYODAndDesksPolicy -Identity Test -DeviceDataCollection Enabled
Grant-CSTeamsBYODAndDesksPolicy -PolicyName Test -Identity testuser@test.onmicrosoft.com

claims.claim: The documented client policy requires MicrosoftTeams module version 6.5.0 or later.
claims.quote: First, ensure that your Microsoft Teams module is on version 6.5.0 or higher.

claims.claim: The client data collection policy is off by default in government clouds.
claims.quote: For government clouds, this policy is off by default.

claims.claim: No admin UI for DeviceDataCollection is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: DeviceDataCollection admin center; CsTeamsBYODAndDesksPolicy DeviceDataCollection configuration Teams admin center policy. Read bookable-desks and bring-your-own-device: PowerShell, no UI for this policy.

claims.claim: The linked Get-PlacesSettings reference documents both the printed check and the Set-PlacesSettings change call.
claims.quote:
Get-PlacesSettings
 [-ReadFromPrimary]
claims.fix: Keep only 'Get-PlacesSettings -ReadFromPrimary' in controls[5].api.call with the existing docs URL; this removes the non-code '(check)' and the change command not documented at that URL. The change syntax is verified separately at the already-cited Configure buildings and floors page.

claims.claim: Set-PlacesSettings requires both Exchange MailRecipients and Places TenantPlacesManagement.
claims.quote: You must have both the Exchange MailRecipients role and the Places TenantPlacesManagement role.

claims.claim: EnableBuildings is off by default for tenants onboarded before 1 August 2026.
claims.quote: Starting August 1, 2026, this is ON by default for newly onboarded tenants. For all other tenants, this setting is OFF by default.

claims.claim: No UI for the tenant EnableBuildings switch is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: enableBuildings admin center settings; EnableBuildings building visibility PowerShell Microsoft Places setting. Read get-placessettings, set-placessettings and quick-setup-buildings-floors: PowerShell visibility control, no UI switch.

claims.claim: No switch dedicated specifically to the new desk analytics release is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams desk utilization analytics disable; Teams desk analytics default 570648. Read bookable-desks, bring-your-own-device, set-placessettings and MC1490906: general collection and distinct Places controls, no dedicated release switch.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not said whether the portal cloud-data setting governs the new desk analytics.
claims.quote: controls if peripheral data is ingested into the cloud service ... Disabling this setting will stop showing any reports for BYOD rooms or Desks
claims.fix: Replace this caveat wherever repeated with: 'The portal setting controls peripheral-data ingestion; Microsoft says disabling it stops any BYOD room or desk reports.' Remove the corresponding applicability question. This is a general control whose documented scope includes desk reports, not a dedicated analytics switch.

claims.where: controls[4].note; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls
claims.claim: Microsoft has not said whether DeviceDataCollection governs the new desk analytics.
claims.quote: Disabling this setting for certain users will cause BYOD and desk information to cease flowing to the service. The Teams BYOD and Desk solution requires peripheral data sent from users ... to ... generate reports for BYOD peripherals, BYOD rooms, and Bookable Desks.
claims.fix: Replace this caveat wherever repeated with: 'DeviceDataCollection controls the peripheral-data feed that Microsoft says is required to generate Bookable Desks reports.' Retain that this is a general collection control, not a dedicated analytics switch.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Scope; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Individual desks do not appear in the Pro Management portal unless EnableBuildings is enabled.
claims.quote: also make sure that enableBuildings is enabled for your tenant. If it isn't enabled, the desks don't show in the Pro Management portal.

claims.claim: Get-PlacesSettings requires Exchange Admin or Places TenantPlacesManagement.
claims.quote: You must have either the Exchange Admin role or the Places TenantPlacesManagement role.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Bookable Desks uses peripheral signals crowdsourced from users' Teams desktop clients.
claims.quote: Bookable desks in Microsoft Teams use peripheral data crowdsourced from the Teams desktop client running on the users' laptops to discover peripherals.

claims.claim: The documented desk usage metrics include desk reservation data.
claims.quote: Reservations | The number of reservations for the individual desk or desk pool during the specified date range.

claims.claim: The bookable desks page says no personally identifiable data is collected.
claims.quote: No personally identifiable data is collected.

claims.claim: Learn documents both individual desks and desk pools.
claims.quote: Desk pool accounts, known as 'workspaces' in Exchange ... individual desks, known as 'desk' in Exchange, represents a specific seat in the office.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends individual desks for more detailed utilization analytics.
claims.quote: Microsoft recommends setting up individual desks over desk pools for a better bookable desk user experience, more detailed utilization analytics, and more management capabilities.

claims.claim: The existing Desks usage report supports CSV export.
claims.quote: Export desk usage details metrics as a csv file.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The sources describe reporting, not autonomous desk release, reassignment or other changes to desks or their users by the analytics release.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams desk utilization analytics new preview report roadmap 570648 December 2026. Read roadmap, MC1490906, bookable-desks and Shared Space licensing pages: analytics is reporting; auto-release is a separate capability.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not reconciled the roadmap's desk licensing condition with Learn's preview-report access statement.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams desk utilization analytics new preview report roadmap 570648 December 2026. Read roadmap, MC1490906, bookable-desks and both Shared Space licensing pages: no explicit reconciliation of preview access with this release's desk-license condition.

claims.claim: The downloaded peripheral collection script exports PERIPHERALS data that can be imported to establish desk associations.
claims.quote: Provide the Account information so as to properly associate the peripheral with the right room or desk account. ... Provide the folder path where the PERIPHERALS.csv file will be saved when prompted.

claims.claim: Desk auto-association requires a minimum of two unique signals.
claims.quote: with a minimum of two unique signals and no maximum

claims.claim: The actual EnableBuildings change syntax is Set-PlacesSettings -EnableBuildings 'Default:true'.
claims.quote: Set-PlacesSettings -EnableBuildings 'Default:true'
